## Activity

During June 2019, East City Eye Clinic recorded 186 captures. This figure represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for review of image quality and grading outcomes. The capture total should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the results identified as referable.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 4 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.2. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the images that produced a grading outcome. The result provides a straightforward measure of image quality for the month.

## Grading

A total of 32 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2. Together, these figures summarise the grading workload and the time taken to complete grading during June 2019. The activity, image quality, and grading measures should be reviewed together when monitoring the site’s operational performance.
